profile.name: RIGOL DSA800 频谱分析仪
profile.description: RIGOL DSA800 系列台式频谱分析仪，用于扫描和测量射频信号频谱。该设备支持设置起止频率、中心频率与扫宽、参考电平与幅度刻度、输入衰减、前置放大器、标记与峰值搜索、分辨率带宽/视频带宽，并可读取迹线数据用于实验分析。
profile.description_en: The Rigol DSA800 is a benchtop spectrum analyzer for scanning and measuring RF signal spectra. It supports start/stop/center/span frequency settings, reference level and amplitude scaling, input attenuation, preamplifier control, markers and peak search, resolution/video bandwidth configuration, and trace acquisition for laboratory analysis.
